instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements with major airline partners (United, Delta, American, Alaska and others). SKYW bears fuel risk only on pro-rate operations.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase agreements. United, Delta, American, Alaska bear fuel risk for contracted flights. SKYW bears fuel risk on pro-rate (~4% of ASMs). Avg price $1.70/gal in 2016. No hedging program.
